messages:
Maya: Quick thread  proposal to add an explicit 'uncertainty' annotation on the route heatmap so p95 markers show confidence, not just value. Sketch: https://redwood-internal.screens/uncertainty-annot.png
Omar: Love explicitness. Could be a small chevron badge next to p95 in the legend that expands to show sample rate, estimated variance, and a link to docs.
Janet: Accessibility first: the expanded panel must be keyboard-focusable and read by screen readers. Use `aria-expanded` and a descriptive label: 'p95 confidence details'.
Alex: UX note: avoid overloading the legend. Make the badge compact (16px) and open a lightweight popover, not a full modal. Popover should anchor to the legend entry.
Maya: Copy drafts: badge hover title: 'p95 confidence'. Popover header: 'Estimated p95 (sampling affects accuracy)'. Body line 1: 'sample rate: 12%'. Body line 2: 'uncertainty: moderate (±40ms)'. Action: 'Increase sampling' button.
Janet: Contrast/focus: the badge must meet touch target size (44px) or be grouped with the legend label to reach accessibility sizing. Also add a visible focus ring and `role=button` for screen readers.
Omar: Edge cases: if sample rate <5% show the badge in 'warning' state (amber) and default the p95 overlay to dimmed. Tooltip: 'Low sample  p95 unreliable'.
Alex: Timepicker tie-in: when user expands badge, include a small control to 'Show full window' which toggles a temporary wider time window (helps if low sample is due to tight range). Keyboard: support Enter to toggle.
DesignBot: CSS hint: `.uncertainty-badge{ width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:3px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffb84d,#ff8a00); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);} .popover{ min-width:220px; padding:10px; }`
Maya: Motion: popover fades in 160ms and the p95 overlay should pulse once if confidence was previously hidden, to draw attention.
Janet: Add QA items: keyboard focus order (legend -> badge -> popover), screen-reader reads sample rate and uncertainty, color contrast checks for badge and popover backgrounds.
Omar: I'll update the figma with the badge and popover states, include amber warning and hatch fallback for low contrast. Posting link in thread when done. ETA 4pm PT.
Maya: Thanks! I'll review and add microcopy tweaks. :thumbsup:
